Based on the visual evidence in the image, here are the screen locations for the specified parts of the M4-style rifle:

1)  **The optical scope:** **bottom-right-near-camera** (The blurry dark shape in the bottom right corner is the top of the rifle, where the scope would be located).
2)  **The tall FRONT SIGHT POST:** **off-screen** (The front of the gun extends out of the frame to the right and is not visible).
3)  **The collapsible stock:** **off-screen** (The rear of the gun is behind the player/camera and not visible on screen).
4)  **The long cylindrical barrel/handguard:** **off-screen** (The barrel points towards the right edge of the screen and is cut off).
5)  **Overall direction:** The **BARREL/muzzle points AWAY from the camera into the scene** (to the right).
